# Overview

This report retrieves 2024 research articles for a set of psychology journals from OpenAlex and compares their primary subfields with each journal's expected topical focus. It summarizes the distribution of subfields and highlights potential mismatches for further review.

# Journals and expected subfields

```{r journal-config, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
journal_focus <- data.frame(
  journal = c(
    "Psychological Science",
    "Journal of Personality and Social Psychology",
    "Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition",
    "Journal of Occupational and Organizational Psychology",
    "Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences"
  ),
  source_id = c(
    "S58854535",
    "S29984966",
    "S18666220",
    "S87328381",
    "S125754415"
  ),
  focus_subfields = I(list(
    c("Cognitive Neuroscience", "Experimental and Cognitive Psychology", "Social Psychology", "Developmental and Educational Psychology"),
    c("Social Psychology", "Clinical Psychology", "Experimental and Cognitive Psychology"),
    c("Cognitive Neuroscience", "Experimental and Cognitive Psychology", "Developmental and Educational Psychology"),
    c("Organizational Behavior and Human Resource Management", "Social Psychology", "Applied Psychology"),
    c()  # PNAS is interdisciplinary - no specific focus subfields
  )),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

journal_focus$focus_subfields_lower <- lapply(journal_focus$focus_subfields, function(values) tolower(values))
journal_focus$focus_summary <- vapply(
  journal_focus$focus_subfields,
  function(values) {
    if (length(values) == 0) {
      "Not specified"
    } else {
      paste(values, collapse = ", ")
    }
  },
  character(1)
)

focus_summary_table <- data.frame(
  Journal = journal_focus$journal,
  `OpenAlex source ID` = journal_focus$source_id,
  `Expected subfields` = journal_focus$focus_summary,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat(create_datatable_html(focus_summary_table, "journal-focus-table"))
cat(render_datatable_script("journal-focus-table", "{paging: false, searching: false, info: false}"))
```

# Helper notes

- Set the environment variable `OPENALEX_EMAIL` before knitting to include your contact email in requests, per OpenAlex best practices.
- Update the `journal_focus` table if you need to reflect different expectations for each journal.

# Retrieve 2024 articles

```{r retrieve}
article_data <- fetch_all_journals(journal_focus, year = 2024)
analysis <- prepare_article_tables(article_data, journal_focus)
articles_enriched <- analysis$articles_enriched
subfield_counts <- analysis$subfield_counts
article_table <- analysis$article_table
n_articles <- nrow(article_data)
```

```{r article-summary, echo=FALSE}
cat(sprintf("Total articles retrieved: **%d**", n_articles))
```

# Subfield counts by journal {.tabset}

```{r subfield-counts, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(subfield_counts) == 0) {
  cat("No subfield data available for the selected journals.")
} else {
  for (journal in unique(articles_enriched$journal)) {
    # Count total articles for this journal
    journal_total <- nrow(articles_enriched[articles_enriched$journal == journal, ])

    cat("## ", journal, " (n=", journal_total, ")", "\n\n")

    # Get subfields for this journal
    journal_subfields <- subfield_counts[subfield_counts$journal == journal, ]
    journal_subfields_display <- journal_subfields[, c("primary_subfield", "article_count"), drop = FALSE]
    names(journal_subfields_display) <- c("Primary subfield", "Article count")

    table_id <- paste0("subfield-table-", gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "-", tolower(journal)))
    cat(create_datatable_html(journal_subfields_display, table_id))
    cat(render_datatable_script(table_id, "{pageLength: 25, order: [[1, 'desc']], paging: true, searching: true, info: true}"))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

# Topic coverage summary

```{r topic-coverage, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Define psychology-related keywords
psychology_keywords <- c(
  "psychology", "psycholog", "cognitive", "behavioral", "social",
  "clinical", "developmental", "educational", "organizational",
  "occupational", "applied psychology", "experimental psychology",
  "neuroscience", "psychiatry", "psychometric"
)

coverage_data <- data.frame()

for (journal in unique(articles_enriched$journal)) {
  journal_articles <- articles_enriched[articles_enriched$journal == journal, ]
  total <- nrow(journal_articles)

  # Count articles matching core focus
  core_match <- sum(journal_articles$focus_match == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Count articles with psychology-related subfields (those that don't match core but mention psychology)
  psychology_related <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(journal_articles))) {
    subfield <- tolower(journal_articles$primary_subfield[i])
    if (is.na(subfield) || subfield == "") next

    is_core <- journal_articles$focus_match[i] == TRUE
    is_psych <- any(sapply(psychology_keywords, function(kw) grepl(kw, subfield, fixed = TRUE)))

    if ((is.na(is_core) || !is_core) && is_psych) {
      psychology_related <- psychology_related + 1
    }
  }

  # Count unrelated articles
  unrelated <- total - core_match - psychology_related

  coverage_data <- rbind(coverage_data, data.frame(
    Journal = journal,
    `Core Topics (%)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * core_match / total),
    `Core Topics (n)` = core_match,
    `Psychology-Related (%)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * psychology_related / total),
    `Psychology-Related (n)` = psychology_related,
    `Unrelated (%)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * unrelated / total),
    `Unrelated (n)` = unrelated,
    `Total` = total,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

# Display coverage summary
cat(create_datatable_html(coverage_data, "coverage-summary-table"))
cat(render_datatable_script("coverage-summary-table", "{paging: false, searching: false, info: false}"))
```

# Article-level view {.tabset}

```{r article-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(article_table) == 0) {
  cat("No articles retrieved for the configured journals.")
} else {
  for (journal in unique(article_table$Journal)) {
    # Count articles for this journal
    journal_article_count <- nrow(article_table[article_table$Journal == journal, ])

    cat("## ", journal, " (n=", journal_article_count, ")", "\n\n")

    # Get articles for this journal
    journal_articles <- article_table[article_table$Journal == journal, , drop = FALSE]

    table_id <- paste0("article-table-", gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "-", tolower(journal)))
    cat(create_datatable_html(journal_articles, table_id, allow_html = c("Title", "DOI")))
    cat(render_datatable_script(
      table_id,
      "{\n      pageLength: 25,\n      order: [[0, 'asc']],\n      scrollX: true,\n      createdRow: function(row, data) {\n        var status = data[data.length - 1];\n        if (status === 'Different') {\n          $(row).addClass('status-different');\n        } else if (status === 'Matches') {\n          $(row).addClass('status-matches');\n        } else {\n          $(row).addClass('status-unknown');\n        }\n      }\n    }"
    ))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

# LLM-based article classification

```{r llm-classification-setup, include=FALSE}
# Load ASJC (All Science Journal Classification) fields from CSV
asjc_data <- read.csv("ASJC_fields.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Format as "Code. Description" for the LLM prompt
asjc_fields <- paste(asjc_data$Code, ".", asjc_data$Description)
```

```{r llm-classification, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("## Overview\n\n")
cat("This section uses LLM-based classification to categorize articles into ASJC fields based on their abstracts.\n\n")

# Only process a sample of articles due to API rate limits and cost
# Process up to 100 articles per journal
sample_articles <- article_data %>%
  group_by(journal) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("**Note:** Processing a sample of", nrow(sample_articles), "articles (up to 100 per journal) for demonstration.\n\n")

if (!requireNamespace("ellmer", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("**Note:** The 'ellmer' package is required for LLM classification. Install it with: `install.packages('ellmer')`\n\n")
} else {
  # Check for OpenAI API key
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")

  if (!nzchar(api_key)) {
    cat("**Note:** OpenAI API key (OPENAI_API_KEY) not found. Set the environment variable to enable classification.\n\n")
  } else {
    # Fetch abstracts for sample articles (with caching)
    cat("Fetching abstracts from Crossref (with session cache)...")
    sample_articles$abstract <- fetch_abstracts_with_rate_limit(sample_articles, pause_interval = 5)

    abstracts_found <- sum(!is.na(sample_articles$abstract))
    cat(" Found abstracts for", abstracts_found, "articles.\n\n")

    if (abstracts_found > 0) {
      # Classify articles with abstracts using batch processing
      cat("Classifying articles with gpt-5-mini...\n")

      # Filter to only articles with abstracts
      articles_to_classify <- sample_articles[!is.na(sample_articles$abstract), ]

      if (nrow(articles_to_classify) > 0) {
        classifications <- classify_articles_batch(articles_to_classify, asjc_fields)
        sample_articles$llm_classification <- NA_character_
        sample_articles$llm_classification[!is.na(sample_articles$abstract)] <- classifications
      }
      cat("Done.\n\n")

      # Create display table with comparison
      classification_display <- sample_articles %>%
        filter(!is.na(abstract) & !is.na(llm_classification)) %>%
        mutate(
          agreement = tolower(primary_subfield) == tolower(llm_classification),
          agreement_label = ifelse(agreement, "✓ Agrees", "✗ Disagrees")
        ) %>%
        select(journal, title, primary_subfield, llm_classification, agreement_label) %>%
        rename(
          Journal = journal,
          Title = title,
          `OpenAlex Field` = primary_subfield,
          `LLM Classification` = llm_classification,
          Agreement = agreement_label
        )

      if (nrow(classification_display) > 0) {
        cat("## Article-level classifications\n\n")
        cat(create_datatable_html(classification_display, "llm-classification-table", allow_html = c("Title")))
        cat(render_datatable_script("llm-classification-table", "{pageLength: 10, order: [[0, 'asc']], scrollX: true}"))

        # Create agreement summary by journal
        cat("\n## Classification agreement by journal\n\n")

        agreement_summary <- sample_articles %>%
          filter(!is.na(abstract) & !is.na(llm_classification)) %>%
          mutate(
            agreement = tolower(primary_subfield) == tolower(llm_classification)
          ) %>%
          group_by(journal) %>%
          summarise(
            `Total Classified` = n(),
            `Agreement Count` = sum(agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Agreement Rate (%)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * sum(agreement, na.rm = TRUE) / n()),
            .groups = 'drop'
          ) %>%
          rename(Journal = journal)

        cat(create_datatable_html(agreement_summary, "llm-agreement-table"))
        cat(render_datatable_script("llm-agreement-table", "{paging: false, searching: false, info: false}"))
      } else {
        cat("No articles with abstracts were successfully classified.\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("No abstracts were found. Classification skipped.\n")
    }
  }
}
```
